character.background: Original Lighthouse before the tactical expansion.
character.name: Mara

choices.text: Wade the causeway to the front door

scenes.text: Rain lashes the shingle. The lighthouse on the rock went dark three nights ago, and two ships have broken on the reef since. The keeper's daughter grips your arm: "My father is still out there." A causeway runs to the rock, half under the tide. A goat path climbs the cliff behind the tower.
scenes.title: The Shore

scenes.text: The tower door is iron, swollen with salt, and locked. Through the keyhole you hear men laughing and dice rattling.
scenes.title: The Iron Door

scenes.text: You haul yourself onto the iron gallery that rings the top of the tower. A cracked window opens onto the lamp room.
scenes.title: The Gallery

choices.text: Creep past them up the stair (Stealth -2)

scenes.text: The lock gives with a soft click. Inside, two wreckers play dice by a lantern, their backs to the stair.
scenes.title: The Store Room

scenes.text: Two wreckers come at you with long knives, cursing.
scenes.title: Wreckers!

scenes.text: The great lamp is cold. The keeper sits bound to a chair. Over him stands Grey Hollis, sword drawn. "Ships on the reef mean cargo on the beach," he says. "Walk away."
scenes.title: The Lamp Room

scenes.text: Hollis laughs and comes at you.
scenes.title: Steel in the Dark

scenes.text: Hollis weighs your words, and your sword, and lowers his blade. He walks out into the rain. You free the keeper, and together you light the lamp. Far out at sea, a ship turns away from the reef.
scenes.title: Ending: The Light Returns

scenes.text: Hollis falls. You cut the keeper free, and his trembling hands relight the lamp. "The light will burn every night while I live," he says. "And you will never pay for a meal in this village again."
scenes.title: Ending: The Keeper's Debt
